Place 1 and 7 on the circle. Each of the two arcs from 1 to 7 must be increasing, so each arc is determined by its set of interior numbers. The numbers 2 through 6 can each go on either arc, giving $2^5 = 32$ ways. Fixing 1 in place accounts for rotations, and the two arcs are distinguished by their direction from 1, so mirror images are counted separately.

ANSWER: 32
